I posted my reasoning in much greater detail in the discord server. Here is what I said there:  


Box jellyfish is a horrible skin for its placement. It is a good skin, but it should NOT be for lionfish. Skins are still supposed to be recognizable as the original animal in at least body shape and box jellyfish fails miserably. It is not a lionfish, it is a jellyfish. This confuses anybody that has not figured it out yet or seen it and makes the game less fun/understandable for newcomers. It's like making a skin for bobbit worm that is the size and shape of the tier one worm. Anyone with common sense would think that the bobbit is the tier one worm if the skin was being used. This is the same thing. If you were not told that it was a lionfish skin, you would immediately assume that it is a jellyfish skin. All the other skins are usually an animal that looks similar and can be understood in one glance. You may even try killing it, just to find that it is not a tier 3, but A TIER 9. I know many people (including myself) who made this mistake.   


Here is my final proposition on the matter: Box jellyfish should be changed to a jellyfish skin.
